scope: Case-sensitive lexicographic inventory indices 67-80 in vault/Literature/Papers/Entries (Effect through Y Social)
method: Read extraction rules, model notation, and paper template first. Independently checked current note claims, metadata, source locators, model/study omissions, footnotes, and warning state against primary sources. Cached local sources are hashed below; where no local source cache exists, the source URL and checked sections/lines are recorded.

entries.note: The Effect of People Recommenders on Echo Chambers and Polarization.md
entries.checks: Abstract correctly attributed to journal HTML; Algorithm 1 schedule checked: Alpha, S proposals, rejections do not advance proposal counter, accepted-edge replacement and R_MAX cutoff; BC and epistemological state/transitions, initialization, recommender scores and CDF normalization, paired controls, NCI/RWC, and experiments checked against cited sections/equations. Literal DJI u/v and OBA-normalizer source inconsistencies are documented rather than silently repaired. Original reference list/order left intact.

entries.note: The Focused Organization of Social Ties.md
entries.checks: Visually checked scanned pp. 1019-24 and 1028-31. Shared-focus tie formation, transitivity, focus-based versus non-focus bridges, correct bridge-direction conditions (smaller/less constraining/fewer foci, less investment, incompatible foci), and the personal-network density proposition/Detroit illustration match the source. The article is theoretical, not an executable simulation.

entries.note: The ODD Protocol for Describing Agent-Based and Other Simulation Models- A Second Update to Improve Clarity- Replication- and Structural Realism.md
entries.checks: Freshly checked JASSS metadata/abstract and §§1-2: seven ODD elements across Overview/Design concepts/Details; additions on guidance, complex-model summaries, rationale/evaluation and code links are represented accurately. No model extraction is required for a reporting protocol.

Checked complete 23-page primary PDF through browser PDF text. Construct-SC's K-bit vectors are correctly identified as transactive-memory perceptions, separate from actual knowledge; personal/group/global fallback and threshold, fixed shared group memberships, activation/forgetting without inventing an update equation, interaction drives, and Tables 2-3 experimental factors/constants/outcomes agree with pp. 4-10. Corrected note now uses compact notation and does not claim all agent knowledge is a K-bit vector.

entries.note: The Prosocial Ranking Challenge- Reducing Polarization on Social Media without Sacrificing Engagement.md
entries.checks: Checked arXiv abstract and Introduction, recruitment/assignment, treatment descriptions, outcome definitions and pooled results. N=9,386, five treatments plus control, three platforms, September 2024-February 2025, >=1-week inclusion, intervention summaries, collected data counts, -0.027 SD pooled polarization and other stated outcomes are supported. Fixed Alexander P. Landry display name and linked Yph Lelkes to a newly created author note after confirming the source roster. The new author file is listed separately below.

Checked Cambridge metadata/abstract and meta-analysis methods/results. Correctly distinguishes the 27-study inventory from the 25-study/27-arm effect-size analysis after four arms lacked variance data; Glass's Delta, Hedges' G, Cochran Q/I2=.85, random-effects estimate .39 (95% CI .231-.554), 24/27 favorable signs, target heterogeneity and near-zero-standard-error intercept caveat are supported.

entries.note: The latent cognitive structures of social networks.md
entries.checks: Checked Poisson NNTuck rate, variant constraints, Algorithm 2 initialization and V/U/Y/G update order and averaging, restart counts, nonidentifiability/split-LRT caveats, cross-validation masks and AUC. The note no longer implies ordinary Wilks LRT is valid.

entries.note: Towards operational validation of LLM-agent social simulations- a replicated study of a Reddit-like technology forum.md
entries.checks: Checked server/user state, exact three-choice action menus and LLM repeated choice until activity budget, feed ordering/visibility, interest feedback, churn-before-growth, calibration table, graph construction, and validation outcomes against §§3.2-3.4/Table 4.

entries.note: User Behavior Simulation with Large Language Model based Agents.md
entries.checks: Checked version/author roster and corrected v3 date, six source action types, activity distribution, memory similarity/reinforcement/forgetting/retrieval and reflection, prompt/action sequence, and intervention configurations in the source experiments.

entries.note: Using artificial agents to understand laboratory experiments of common-pool resources with real agents.md
entries.checks: Checked printed pp. 75-102 and equations 6.1-6.8, investment modes/payoffs, learning and configurations against the author PDF. PDF is 28 pages and contains no chapter bibliography; consolidated book bibliography was not obtained. The note does not invent references or claim this chapter contains a bibliography; this access limitation is recorded here, not as fulltext unavailable because chapter text itself is accessible.
entries.report_correction: Root matched the URL to the audited note: underscore spelling in common_pool and with_real-agents. Source cache unchanged.

entries.note: Value-based large language model agent simulation for mutual evaluation of trust and interpersonal closeness.md
entries.checks: Checked PMC metadata/abstract and method/results sections; two-stage value controllability and pairwise dialogue design, languages, runs, prompts and reciprocal trust/closeness outcomes match source.

entries.note: When -I- Becomes -We- Modelling Dynamic Identity on Autonomous Agents.md
entries.checks: Checked Eqs. 1-11 and both scenarios: thresholded normative match is separate from comparative fit; accessibility reinforcement, dictator-game offer and trash-task action rules are stated without claiming a universal formula not supplied by Eq. 10.

entries.note: Why Does Facebook Fail to Catalyze Diverse Friendship Formations.md
entries.checks: Checked complete two-page PDF: FIRMAN coordinates/weights, tie distance, reciprocal feasibility, TC/TO and scenario distributions/trial count/results match. Source's printed TC < current friendship count conflicts with the maximum-capacity definition; note explicitly records this conflict and its operational interpretation.

entries.note: Y Social- an LLM-powered Social Media Digital Twin.md
entries.checks: Checked source version/metadata, profile fields, action-specific server primitives, follow-score sampling, Algorithm 1 hourly active-count schedule and follow-loop/comment conflict, growth timing, and §4.1 case configuration.
